question_summary: Request to substitute a fan-powered VAV box in lieu of the specified single-duct VAV terminal unit due to lead times; submitter states cost-neutral and no schedule impact.
proposed_solution: Approve use of a fan-powered alternate VAV box in place of the specified single-duct VAV terminal unit.
deadline_text: A response within three business days would be appreciated.
routing_rationale: As a mechanical equipment substitution without stated cost or schedule impact, it should be reviewed by the Mechanical Engineer of Record.
